# Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**Foundation:** Sand background `#F8F4EC`, deep teal text `#0D3B3E`, seafoam `#8FD6C8`, coral accent `#FF6B57`. Display type: Fraunces (warm serif); UI/body: Inter. Imagery: abstract tide shapes and soft gradients — no stock photos.

**1. Nav** — Sticky, sand with blur on scroll. Wave-glyph logo left; Product / Pricing / Changelog center; coral "Start free" pill right.

**2. Hero** — Centered column: eyebrow "For teams of 2–20," H1 "Plan the week together. Then let it flow," one-sentence subhead, dual CTAs (coral primary, ghost secondary). Below: angled product screenshot in a rounded card with floating planner widgets. Copy: plain-spoken, benefit-first.

**3. Logo strip** — Grayscale fictional studio wordmarks; caption "Trusted by 1,200+ small teams."

**4. Problem** — Two-column split: left, "Mondays shouldn't feel like triage"; right, three pain points with line icons (Slack sprawl, dead spreadsheets, mystery priorities). Copy names real frustrations bluntly.

**5. How it works** — Three horizontal numbered cards: "Sync Monday (15 min)," "Build the week together," "Adjust as tides shift." Teal fills, minimal illustrations.

**6. Feature bento** — Asymmetric 2×2 grid: shared weekly canvas, async check-ins, workload balancing, Slack + Google integrations. One tile flips to dark teal for contrast. Copy: verb-led feature titles, one-line support.

**7. Rhythm moment** — Full-bleed seafoam gradient with a slowly animated tide curve; centered line: "Your week has a rhythm. Work with it." The emotional signature beat.

**8. Testimonials** — One large quote with avatar, two smaller flanking quotes. Real-sounding names, team sizes, no star ratings.

**9. Pricing teaser** — Two cards: Free (≤5 people), Team $8/seat with coral border highlight. Link to full pricing.

**10. Final CTA** — Deep teal band: "Make this week the calm kind." Email input + button, no navigation clutter.

**11. Footer** — Four link columns, wave divider, tagline "Built for small crews."

# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**Key upgrades:** coral reserved exclusively for CTAs, an interactive hero demo, a named villain, concrete proof points, and a product-truth rhythm section.

**Foundation:** Sand `#F8F4EC`, ink teal `#0D3B3E`, seafoam `#8FD6C8`, coral `#FF6B57` — used *only* for buttons and highlights, so every coral pixel signals "act." Fraunces display / Inter body. Motion: slow, tide-like easing; disabled under reduced-motion. Tide metaphors capped at one per section.

**1. Nav** — Sticky, sand blurring on scroll. Logo left; Product / Pricing / Changelog as in-page anchors; coral "Start free" pill right.

**2. Hero** — Replace the static screenshot with a lightly interactive "sample week": a weekly board visitors can nudge — drag a card, watch the workload bar rebalance. Eyebrow "For teams of 2–20." H1: "The week, planned together." Subhead: one sentence on the Monday sync becoming a living plan. CTAs: "Start free — no card" and "Explore a sample week."

**3. Proof strip** — Grayscale wordmarks plus hard numbers: "1,200 teams · 12-min average Monday sync." Stats beat captions.

**4. Problem** — Name the villain: the Monday status meeting. H2 "Your status meeting is a meeting about a document." Three pains, line icons: Slack sprawl, stale spreadsheets, invisible workload. Blunt, second person.

**5. How it works** — Frame as a full weekly loop, not features: **Monday** 15-min sync → **Midweek** async adjustments → **Friday** retro with automatic rollover. Rollover is the differentiator; say it plainly.

**6. Feature bento** — Four tiles, shared weekly canvas dominant (double-width, seafoam fill). Then async check-ins, workload balancing, integrations (small — table stakes don't get hero space). Verb-led titles. One dark-teal tile for rhythm.

**7. Rhythm moment** — Full-bleed seafoam gradient; animated wave whose *height tracks workload across the week*. Line: "Your week has a rhythm. Work with it." Emotion plus product truth.

**8. Testimonials** — One oversized quote with a hard outcome: "Planning went from 90 minutes to 20." Name, role, team size. Two small supporting quotes flank it.

**9. Pricing teaser** — Two cards; Team ($8/seat) coral-bordered. Microcopy: "Free for 5, forever. No card required."

**10. Final CTA** — Deep teal band: "Make this week the calm kind." Email input, "2-minute setup" reassurance.

**11. Footer** — Four link columns, wave divider, "Built for small crews."
